package com.platform.events.iam.user;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record UserCreatedData(
    String onePointZero,
    String sciHundred,
    String tenth,
    String tiny,
    String small,
    String edgeLow,
    String big,
    String huge,
    String e21,
    String e20,
    String negZero,
    String negZeroF,
    String neg,
    String minDouble,
    String maxDouble,
    String overflow,
    String capE,
    String third,
    String list,
    Integer plain
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static UserCreatedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new UserCreatedData(
            (String) map.get("onePointZero"),
            (String) map.get("sciHundred"),
            (String) map.get("tenth"),
            (String) map.get("tiny"),
            (String) map.get("small"),
            (String) map.get("edgeLow"),
            (String) map.get("big"),
            (String) map.get("huge"),
            (String) map.get("e21"),
            (String) map.get("e20"),
            (String) map.get("negZero"),
            (String) map.get("negZeroF"),
            (String) map.get("neg"),
            (String) map.get("minDouble"),
            (String) map.get("maxDouble"),
            (String) map.get("overflow"),
            (String) map.get("capE"),
            (String) map.get("third"),
            (String) map.get("list"),
            (Integer) map.get("plain")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("onePointZero", onePointZero);
        map.put("sciHundred", sciHundred);
        map.put("tenth", tenth);
        map.put("tiny", tiny);
        map.put("small", small);
        map.put("edgeLow", edgeLow);
        map.put("big", big);
        map.put("huge", huge);
        map.put("e21", e21);
        map.put("e20", e20);
        map.put("negZero", negZero);
        map.put("negZeroF", negZeroF);
        map.put("neg", neg);
        map.put("minDouble", minDouble);
        map.put("maxDouble", maxDouble);
        map.put("overflow", overflow);
        map.put("capE", capE);
        map.put("third", third);
        map.put("list", list);
        map.put("plain", plain);
        return map;
    }
}
